item.title: OBSCURA Announce ‘Stardust 2026 US Tour’ + Japan Shows & Festival Dates
item.description: German progressive death metal masters, OBSCURA, are set to return to the U.S. this spring for the ‘Stardust Tour.’ The 18-date run begins on March 15th at the legendary Whisky-A-Go-Go in Hollywood, includes key stops in Austin, Philadelphia, and Detroit, and concludes on April 3rd in Roseville, CA. item.title: MYRATH Release Second Single ‘The Funeral’ with New Video
item.description: Tunisian–French metal innovators Myrath release their new single and video ‘The Funeral’ through earMUSIC. A track that approaches death with surprising brightness and emotional uplift. Instead of darkness, the band delivers a genre-blending anthem that transforms farewell into something empowering and beautiful. A seamless, masterfully crafted piece that feels destined, natural, and utterly breathtaking. Alongside the single, Myrath present a cinematic new music […]
